title: Long-time behavior of a nonlocal and non-monotone SPDE-ODE system arising in electrophysiology
summary: This paper concerns a coupled semilinear SPDE-ODE system modelling the electropermeabilization phenomenon, which designates a transient increase in cell membrane permeability induced by short, high-voltage electric pulses. We present a stochastically perturbed electroporation model that couples electrostatic equations for the electric potential in the extra- and intracellular domains and a nonlinear evolution law for the transmembrane potential jump with an ordinary differential equation describing the porosity degree of the membrane.
